title: Enterprise LLM Capacity Planning & Three-Watermark GPU Sizing Master Guide: QPS, TPM/TPS/PTU Conversion, Little's Law Concurrency & TTFT/TPOT/Goodput SLAs

workload_basis.enterprise_traffic: 50,000 DAU -> 50 Peak RPS (4,096 In / 600 Out Tokens, 60% Prefix Cache Hit Rate)
workload_basis.sla_targets: P95 TTFT <= 800 ms, P99 TPOT <= 20 ms (Streaming >= 50 tok/s)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Weight-Only Naive Sizing (2*Psi Rule Only, Ignoring Little's Law KV Pool & HBM Bandwidth Wall)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Peak-Provisioned Uncached BF16 / 100% Dedicated PTU Sizing (Zero Prefix Deduction or Spillover)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Over-provisioned legacy sizing wasting >55% budget during off-peak hours

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Three-Watermark Sizing (max[HBM, BW, Compute]) + Little's Law Active Slots + Block FP8
tiers.recommended_scenario: Rigorous first-principles capacity sizing for dedicated single-cluster enterprise deployments

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Three-Watermark Sizer + Prefix Cache Deduction + P80 Base Fleet + P20 PAYGO Spillover
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production gold standard achieving 5.19x per-GPU Goodput and -64.5% monthly TCO vs. Tier 2
